name: pollen
description: Pollen — free cozy farming game that runs in the browser
comment: server/ is deliberately NOT a workspace — see server/README.md. It is parked as the co-op reference and does not currently build.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pollen/client
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pollen/client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pollen/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @pollen/shared
